name: Seelos Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Seelos Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of novel therapeutics for central nervous system (CNS) disorders and rare diseases. The company is headquartered in Sarasota, Florida, and their pipeline includes product candidates for the treatment of acute indications and chronic diseases. Seelos Therapeutics seeks to address unmet medical needs by advancing innovative therapies through clinical development.
